goalbuddy_receipt_v1.summary: Implemented the compact accessible Preferences & shortcuts dialog with focus trapping/return, Escape, restore defaults, and reduced-motion support. Added strict global v1 storage with atomic malformed/future-version fallback and tab-local failure resilience, separate from workspace state. Wired precise modifier, marquee containment/touching, logical/exact click depth, and individual outlines into the editor while preserving Alt/double-click, gestures, serialization, and history. Added meaningful storage, UX, and interaction coverage. Typecheck, 81 targeted tests, and production build pass.
